# MY Hardware & Construction Supply — Full Inventory & Technical Reference

Official digital manifest and wholesale purchasing guide for MY Hardware & Construction Supply (Tacloban City, Leyte, Philippines).

## Business Information
- **Business Name**: MY Hardware & Construction Supply (formerly Manna Hardware)
- **Primary Location**: National Highway, Abucay / Cabalwan / Nula Tula, Tacloban City, Leyte 6500, Philippines
- **Phone / Mobile**: +63 926 199 5703 / +63 918 987 6543
- **Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/mannaHardwareTAC/
- **Official Website**: https://myhardware.mikashop.online/

## Warehouse Hubs & Depots
1. **Cabalwan Depot (CAB)**: Heavy structural steel, C-purlins, plain bars, welding rods, bulk paints.
2. **Nula Tula Depot (NT)**: Hardware boxes, electrical, sanitary fittings, valves, power tool accessories, security locks.

## Pricing Structure & Commercial Tiers
All clearance items are sold on an As-Is, Where-Is basis at below-retail rates.
- Retail single-piece purchases available at base listed SRP.
- Auto Tier 1: Orders >= ₱10,000 receive 10% instant discount.
- Auto Tier 2: Orders >= ₱25,000 receive 20% contractor discount.
- Auto Tier 3: Orders >= ₱50,000 receive 35% builder discount (Code: BUILDER).
- Auto Tier 4: Orders >= ₱100,000 receive 40% commercial reseller clearance discount (Code: HARDWARE).

1. **Structural & Building Materials**:
   - C-Purlins 2x4 1.2mm HD (Stock: 170 pcs, Cabalwan)
   - C-Purlins 2x4 1.2 (Stock: 46 pcs, Nula Tula)

2. **Plumbing & Sanitary**:
   - GI Pipe Schedule 40 (3/4, 1/2, 1 inch, Samurai brand)
   - Gate Valves & Swing Valves (Kitz, WB, Sunrise)

3. **Paints & Chemical Coatings**:
   - Island Paint Quick Drying Enamel & Primer

   - Bosny Spray Paints & Zinc Chromate
4. **Fasteners & General Hardware**:
   - Black Gypsum Screws (100 pcs/pack)

All physical inspections welcomed on-site before dispatch or self-haul loading.
